From 26d289158e491d5ae34b10eab40b093a40fab7d7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Matthew Brost <matthew.brost@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jul 2024 14:10:08 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] drm/xe: Drop trace_xe_hw_fence_free
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

fence->ctx may be stale memory when trace_xe_hw_fence_free is called
resuling UAF bug when deriving the device name. This tracepoint is not
all that useful, so just drop it.

Fixes: 501c4255c409 ("drm/xe/trace: Print device_id in xe_trace events")
Cc: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Cc: Lucas De Marchi <lucas.demarchi@intel.com>
Cc: Gustavo Sousa <gustavo.sousa@intel.com>
Cc: Radhakrishna Sripada <radhakrishna.sripada@intel.com>
Cc: Matt Roper <matthew.d.roper@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Matthew Brost <matthew.brost@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Rodrigo Vivi <rodrigo.vivi@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240708211008.956384-1-matthew.brost@intel.com
(cherry picked from commit caaf1f44a6a27bae33eee189842c4d8fc21c3b02)
Signed-off-by: Rodrigo Vivi <rodrigo.vivi@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_trace.h b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_trace.h
index 09ca1ad057b0..baba14fb1e32 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_trace.h
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_trace.h
@@ -341,11 +341,6 @@ DEFINE_EVENT(xe_hw_fence, xe_hw_fence_try_signal,
 	     TP_ARGS(fence)
 );
 
-DEFINE_EVENT(xe_hw_fence, xe_hw_fence_free,
-	     TP_PROTO(struct xe_hw_fence *fence),
-	     TP_ARGS(fence)
-);
-
 TRACE_EVENT(xe_reg_rw,
 	TP_PROTO(struct xe_gt *gt, bool write, u32 reg, u64 val, int len),
 
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_hw_fence.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_hw_fence.c
index 35c0063a831a..45a9789cf501 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_hw_fence.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_hw_fence.c
@@ -187,7 +187,6 @@ static void xe_hw_fence_release(struct dma_fence *dma_fence)
 {
 	struct xe_hw_fence *fence = to_xe_hw_fence(dma_fence);
 
-	trace_xe_hw_fence_free(fence);
 	XE_WARN_ON(!list_empty(&fence->irq_link));
 	call_rcu(&dma_fence->rcu, fence_free);
 }

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_trace.h`**
   - Removed the definition of the trace event `xe_hw_fence_free`. This includes:
     - The `DEFINE_EVENT` macro for `xe_hw_fence_free`, which had a prototype and arguments for the `struct xe_hw_fence *fence`.

2. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_hw_fence.c`**
   - Removed the call to `trace_xe_hw_fence_free(fence);` within the `xe_hw_fence_release` function. This line was responsible for tracing the free operation of hardware fences.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `xe_trace.h` and `xe_hw_fence.c` are directly related as they both pertain to the removal of the `xe_hw_fence_free` trace event. The removal of the trace event definition in `xe_trace.h` corresponds to the elimination of its invocation in `xe_hw_fence.c`. This change was made to address a potential use-after-free (UAF) bug caused by the use of stale memory when the trace event was called, indicating that the trace event was deemed unnecessary and potentially harmful.
